svg.aria-label: Career as a city: warehouses in 2015, cloud towers by 2019, GenAI crowns in 2022, bridges to customers in 2024, and a central AI spire in 2026

g.text: THE JOURNEY, BUILT ONE DISTRICT AT A TIME
Multi-PB to GCP · 1B+ records a day
AWS to GCP Databricks, near-zero downtime
COBOL to BigQuery via GenAI, 12 workstreams.
Every district now feeds the AI core.
